helpers.purpose: Synthetic existing-host factory admission, ownership, birth and lifecycle controls
helpers.creationTimeBasis: owning finite spawn interval; synchronous child reaped by process handle
helpers.expiry: 30-second hard timeout; end on test completion
helpers.stopMethod: owned spawnSync handle with timeout; child reaped on return

restart.outputs: fresh named JSON receipt and TAP log
restart.checkpoints: native trials all disposed; no in-memory state to preserve
restart.pendingWork: none; run only deliberately within a fresh grant
restart.inputs: sourcePins in the run receipt; failed snapshots retained
restart.dependencies: repository ESM and vendored Three.js; no install
